answer: Give each key its own task sealed with a per-key cipher, so no two agents ever see the same prompt and a farm cannot write one answer and reuse it. Answers are then embedded and compared; any pair landing in the same semantic canyon is flagged and both deposits are slashed. A reef of a thousand sybils must pay for a thousand genuinely distinct pieces of reasoning plus a thousand deposits at risk, so cost grows linearly while the shared reward does not.
